Ram Mandir Donation Case: Investigation Focuses on Accused's Assets and Security

An investigation into alleged theft of donations for the Ram Mandir in Ayodhya is ongoing, with authorities examining the financial transactions and properties of the accused. Reports indicate that bank accounts of the accused showed transactions significantly exceeding their known income, and properties like houses and plots have been identified. The probe has also expanded to include the role of private security personnel deployed at the temple.
